title: Chiral oxazolidinones via biocatalytic aziridination of unactivated alkenes
title_zh: 通过非活性烯烃生物催化环氧化合成手性氧杂环丁酮酯
abstract: Chiral oxazolidinones are privileged heterocycles broadly used in asymmetric synthesis1 and drug discovery2,3. Conventional synthetic routes rely on a ‘chiral pool’ strategy, where enantiopure amino alcohols are required as key intermediates. Of particular importance are a class of 5-(S)-aminomethyl oxazolidinones that are key scaffolds in next-generation antibiotics targeting multidrug- and extensively drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis4–6. Although many strategies exist to construct chirality at the 4-position (α-to-nitrogen), methods to install the desired 5-stereocentre (α-to-oxygen) remain underdeveloped. Here we report a haemprotein-catalysed aziridination and ring-expansion cascade that enables direct, enantioselective synthesis of clinically relevant and discovery-stage oxazolidinones from simple alkenes. This work advances haemprotein-catalysed nitrene transfer by enabling functionalization of unactivated alkenes, a reactivity previously limited to conjugated systems such as styrenes. Computational analysis further reveals that key mutations introduced through directed evolution are responsible for the enantioselective formation of these products. A biocatalytic aziridination and ring-expansion cascade enables direct, enantioselective synthesis of clinically relevant and discovery-stage chiral oxazolidinones from simple alkenes.
abstract_zh: 手性氧杂环丁酮酯是不对称合成和药物发现中广泛使用的特殊杂环骨架1-3。传统的合成路线依赖于‘手性池’策略，需要将手性氨醇作为关键中间体。其中，5-(S)-氨甲基氧杂环丁酮酯是一类关键骨架，是针对多药耐药和广泛耐药结核分枝杆菌的下一代抗生素的关键支架4-6。虽然存在许多在4位（氮-α）构建手性的策略，但安装期望的5-手性中心（氧-α）的方法仍相对落后。本研究报道了一种血红蛋白催化的环氧化和环扩联反应，能够从简单的烯烃直接、手性选择性地合成临床相关和发现阶段的氧杂环丁酮酯。这项工作通过使能非活性烯烃的官能团化，推进了血红蛋白催化的亚氮转移反应，此前该反应仅限于共轭体系，如苯乙烯。计算分析进一步揭示，通过定向进化引入的关键突变对这些产物的手性选择性形成起着决定性作用。一种生物催化的环氧化和环扩联反应实现了从简单烯烃直接、手性选择性地合成临床相关和发现阶段的手性氧杂环丁酮酯。
